svg.title: It is not the recursion. It is the repetition.
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “It is not the recursion. It is the repetition.” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch showing the full fib(5) recursion tree with every occurrence of fib(2) ringed in red and fib(3) in amber, annotated with 29,860,703 naive calls for fib(35); the same tree with the repeated subtrees struck out and a memo table being filled, annotated with 69 calls and a 432,764 times reduction; an edit-distance grid between kitten and sitting with one cell highlighted and three arrows entering it from above, from the left and from the diagonal labelled delete, insert and substitute; and a memory comparison of a 634.67 megabyte full matrix struck through against 0.33 megabytes for two rows, with the warning that two rows cannot reconstruct the alignment path.
svg.text: It is not the recursion. It is the repetition.
draw it from memory, then compare
